input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full: § 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free affiliate/successor (M&A) assignment right subject only to prompt notice; § 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation and transfer by change of control to Customer's prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor; § 24.3 applies a reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and § 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control. Section 13.3 mirrors this for licence transfers, and no other provision (including the § 9.2 insolvency right) creates a change-of-control exit or re-pricing trigger against us. No redline required.
